objective: Reproduce only the stock M-at-boot factory/product-test entry screen on the purchased v42012 Ditoo Plus, record visible behavior for 20-30 seconds, press no controls after boot, and exit by normal power-cycle. No SD card, no USB service probing, no factory-test stage advancement.

static_evidence.boot_selector: M key / physical key ID1 selects stock test path

preconditions.usb: not required; do not intentionally probe USB during this experiment

steps: Hold M and perform only the normal power-on action.
Once the alternate/test display appears, release M.
Press no other controls and do not insert SD/USB accessories.
Record the display/LED/audio behavior for 20-30 seconds.

evidence_to_capture: whether mode remains stable without input
whether normal boot returns after power-cycle

risk.reason: Entry is a stock factory/product-test mode and no stage advancement is authorized, but exact v42012 factory-mode initialization side effects are not fully characterized.

stop_policy.on_unexpected_write_update_reset_prompt: do not confirm anything; power-cycle normally if stable to do so and stop

authority.grant_scope: ONE stock M-at-boot factory/test-mode entry on the exact purchased v42012 unit, observation only for 20-30 seconds, no controls after entry, SD removed, no USB probing, then normal power-cycle.

result.visible_sequence: brief stock battery/boot icon -> dark screen while M held -> factory/test display after release
result.interpretation: Strongly consistent with Ditoo product flag 42 plus installed firmware suffix 012, i.e. v42012; this is direct on-device visual support for the previously reported installed build.
